name: glint
desc: A liquid-glass status line for Claude Code
typing: A liquid-glass status line for Claude Code
Model, effort, context pressure and git state at a glance
One jq call, one git call, about 20ms per draw
Rounded pill, per-character gradient, no banding
tagline: One rounded pill on your terminal's dark background: model, effort, context pressure and git state at a glance, drawn in about 20ms.
pitch: **glint** replaces the default Claude Code status line with a single glass pill: bright rim, dark body, the model name read straight from the session, an effort color, a context bar that can track auto-compaction, and your branch with a dirty counter.
notice: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. "Claude" and "Claude Code" are Anthropic trademarks.

what.product: status line for the Claude Code CLI
what.shows: model · effort · thinking lamp · project · branch + dirty count · context bar and %
what.look: Powerline caps, per-character RGB gradient, responsive stacking on narrow terminals
what.context: tracks CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW when set, model ceiling otherwise
what.speed: one jq pass, one git pass, ~20ms per draw
what.install: curl -fsSL .../install.sh | zsh (backs up what it replaces)
what.requires: zsh, jq, a Nerd Font with Powerline glyphs
